# Serpent scale

Type: Material | Internal ID: SerpentScale | Source: Serpent | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Serpent scales are materials found in the Ocean.

## Availability

Serpent scales are a drop from Serpents. Notably, they sink in deep water, and can only reliably be obtained by killing Serpents in shallow water, often by dragging them to shore with an Abyssal harpoon.

### Crafting

• Fins of Destiny
• Serpent scale shield
